verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Ollama support, offline/self-hosted operation, air-gapped deployment mode, and OpenAI-compatible API connections that explicitly include llama.cpp-served endpoints, vLLM, and LM Studio as providers, satisfying the core local-model story. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of a fully cloud-free setup, and community evidence notes some features (e.g. RAG) may implicitly favor GPU/cloud paths, leaving a minor gap in real-world verification.
